remarks: Opportunity awaits in Norwalk! This property is being offered AS-IS and is ready for a buyer with vision. Whether you're an investor, contractor, or buyer looking to renovate and make a home your own, this property offers plenty of potential. The home is in need of TLC and updating, providing an excellent opportunity to customize, improve, and add value. Conveniently located near shopping, dining, major roadways, public transportation, and all that Norwalk has to offer. Bring your ideas and imagination and see the possibilities this property has to offer. Property is being sold in its current condition; seller will make no repairs. Buyer to perform their own due diligence regarding condition, improvements, and potential uses.
